000.observed: Asya looks vertically upward while remaining front-facing.
000.evidence: Both yellow pupils sit high in the ochre irises; chin lifts slightly; shoes, apron pocket, and clasped hands remain registered.

022.5.observed: A subtle viewer-right component enters the upward gaze.
022.5.evidence: Pupils remain high but shift to the viewer-right; nose and head follow only slightly; planted lower body is unchanged.

045.observed: The gaze occupies a clear upper-right diagonal.
045.evidence: Pupils and nose move farther viewer-right while the chin remains raised; hair and shoulders follow by a restrained amount.

067.5.observed: The pose approaches the right cardinal from above.
067.5.evidence: Face surface is clearly viewer-right of center with pupils still slightly elevated; feet and pocket remain fixed.

090.observed: Asya looks unmistakably toward the viewer's right edge.
090.evidence: Nose, both pupils, and face surface lie to the viewer-right of head center; the torso is not rotated as a whole.

112.5.observed: The rightward pose begins a controlled downward arc.
112.5.evidence: Pupils lower while remaining viewer-right; chin dips and bangs follow; lower-body registration stays constant.

135.observed: The gaze is clearly diagonal toward the lower-right.
135.evidence: Pupils occupy the lower-right portion of the eyes, with a modest rightward head turn and lowered chin.

157.5.observed: The pose is nearly down with a remaining rightward cue.
157.5.evidence: Chin is lowered and pupils are low; nose and face retain a small viewer-right displacement before the 180 frame.

180.observed: Asya looks vertically downward while staying broadly frontal.
180.evidence: Both pupils sit low beneath the bangs, chin drops centrally, and shoes, apron pocket, and clasp remain anchored.

202.5.observed: A subtle viewer-left component enters the downward gaze.
202.5.evidence: Pupils remain low and shift viewer-left; nose and head follow slightly without moving the planted body.

225.observed: The gaze occupies a clear lower-left diagonal.
225.evidence: Pupils and nose are lower-left of center, with matching eyelid and fringe follow-through.

247.5.observed: The pose approaches the left cardinal from below.
247.5.evidence: Face surface is clearly viewer-left while pupils remain slightly low; scale and baseline stay unchanged.

270.observed: Asya looks unmistakably toward the viewer's left edge.
270.evidence: Nose, both pupils, and face surface lie to the viewer-left of head center; torso, feet, and pocket remain planted.

292.5.observed: The leftward pose begins a controlled upward arc.
292.5.evidence: Pupils rise while remaining viewer-left; chin and bangs lift slightly with no lower-body drift.

315.observed: The gaze is clearly diagonal toward the upper-left.
315.evidence: Pupils occupy the upper-left of the eyes and the nose remains viewer-left; hands and apron keep registration.

337.5.observed: The pose is nearly up with a remaining leftward cue.
337.5.evidence: Pupils are high, chin raised, and face retains a small viewer-left displacement before returning to 000.
